nodes.name: Hangar Deck Fire Drill
nodes.eventIntro: Sirens blare across the lower catwalks as simulated thermal alarms trip.
nodes.eventDescription: Chief Engineer orders an unannounced high-readiness damage control drill.

actions.description: Direct crew to seal airlocks and foam containment.

nodes.title: Hangar Deck Fire Drill

actions.description: Equip the fishermen to catch local predatory species. They'll need bait and scanners to locate and examine their catches.
actions.resultDescription: The 'bane of all fish in the galaxy' were enjoying their leisure time when a gargantuan shadow passed beneath their air-filled boat. A true sea giant decided to respond in kind and attack the fishermen. Luckily, they managed to detect the attack in advance and escape the leviathan's hungry belly. Despite the scare, they do not seem to be discouraged from trying fishing in local waters again, already boasting of having caught quite a few impressive specimens.

actions.description: Provide the fishermen with everything they need to catch various specimens from local shoals and schools.
